description: List per-item vendor terms (ItemSupplier rows): each row's id, item id, vendor id and name, and the vendor's minimum order quantity. Filter by itemId, supplierId, or both. Terms are informational — surfaced, never enforced. Paged (Total pre-paging + limit/offset, default 100, max 500). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

itemId.description: Optional item id (GUID) to narrow the list to one item.

supplierId.description: Optional vendor id (GUID) to narrow the list to one vendor.

name: list_item_vendor_terms
title: List Item Vendor Terms
